domain_claim: digest_step_primitive MUST incorporate all five Collect fields (variable, source, pages, items, body) so that two workflows differing only in Collect parameters produce different digests
notes: CRITICAL bug: current implementation uses catch-all canonical_primitive_name which only hashes 'collect' string. Proof must show different Collect params produce different hasher states.

domain_claim: digest_step_primitive must hash the Collect 'variable' string field; two Collect with same source/pages/items/body but different variable names must produce different digests
notes: Variable field is the loop variable name; e.g., 'x' vs 'y' in 'collect variable: x' vs 'collect variable: y'

domain_claim: digest_step_primitive must hash the Collect 'source' expression string; two Collect with same variable/pages/items/body but different source expressions must produce different digests
notes: Source field is the input expression; e.g., 'list_a' vs 'list_b' are semantically different sources

domain_claim: digest_step_primitive must hash the Collect 'pages' Option<u32> field; two Collect with same variable/source/items/body but different page limits must produce different digests
notes: pages field is Option<u32>; None must serialize to 0, Some(p) must serialize to p.to_le_bytes()

domain_claim: digest_step_primitive must hash the Collect 'items' Option<u32> field; two Collect with same variable/source/pages/body but different page sizes must produce different digests
notes: items field is Option<u32>; None must serialize to 0, Some(i) must serialize to i.to_le_bytes()

domain_claim: digest_step_primitive must recursively hash all body StepAst elements; two Collect with same variable/source/pages/items but different body step content must produce different digests
notes: Each body step: hash step.id then digest_step_primitive recursively. Body with [Set, Finish] vs [Finish] must differ.

domain_claim: For each workflow step, digest_step_primitive is called after hashing the step ID; step ID uniqueness (enforced by validation) ensures different steps contribute differently
notes: Step IDs must be unique per workflow; digest iterates steps and hashes id then primitive

domain_claim: canonical_digest must hash trigger variant and trigger-specific data (cron, event_type); Manual vs Webhook vs Schedule vs Event workflows must have different digests
notes: Each TriggerAst variant has distinct hash inputs

domain_claim: canonical_digest is a pure function; repeated calls on same WorkflowSource produce bit-for-bit identical WorkflowDigest
notes: Cross-run determinism tests in vb_kyyf_cross_run_determinism must pass

contract_clause: CC-DIGEST-003: Artifact digest depends on source digest
domain_claim: compute_compiled_digest hashes serialized WorkflowParts; WorkflowParts.digest is canonical_digest output; artifact digest is function of source digest plus IR
notes: If serialization is non-deterministic, same source could produce different artifact digests

domain_claim: lower_canonical_collect emits 4 nodes: CollectStart, SetConst (inline body Set), CollectPage, CollectFinish; IR nodes faithfully represent Collect primitive fields
notes: CollectStart.limit = pages.unwrap_or(1); CollectStart.page_size = items.unwrap_or(1)

domain_claim: Storage admission must compute compute_compiled_digest(artifact_bytes) and compare to claimed WorkflowDigest; mismatch causes ArtifactDigestMismatch error
notes: Evidence in vb_core_atomic_admission_red.rs line 856

contract_clause: CC-DIGEST-006: No panic on Collect digest

notes: GOD RULE: must use kani::any() for Collect, not hardcoded dummy data

domain_claim: Property: (a = b) implies digest_primitive(a) = digest_primitive(b); and for field differences, digest must differ
notes: proptest must generate pairs of Collect with controlled field differences
